       header\n90\t            )));\n91\t        }\n92\t\n93\t        let parts: Vec<&str> = header[6..].split('/').collect();\n94\t        if parts.len() != 2 {\n95\t            return self.end - self.start + 1\n138\t    }\n139\t}\n140\t\n141\t/// HTTP client for fetching GRIB2 data via byte-range requests\n142\t#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\n143\tpub struct FetchClient {\n144\t /// Fetch a byte range from a URL\n229\t    pub async fn fetch_range(&mut self, url: &str, range: RangeRequest) -> Result<RangeResponse> {\n230\t        let provider = probe logic for a single URL\n198\t    async fn probe_url_inner(&mut self, url: &str) -> Result<ProbeInnerResult, crate::FetchError> {\n199\t        let start = std::time::Instant::now();\n200\t\n201\t        // Use the client's probe method to get basic connection info\n202\t        let probe_info = self.client.probe(url).await?;\n203\t        let std::time::Instant::now();\n213\t\n214\t        let range_response = if supports_range && content_length > 1024 {\n215\t            Some(self.client.fetch_head(url, 1024).await?)\n216\t        } else {\n217\t            None\n218\t        };\n219\t\n220\t        let ttfb = range_start.elapsed();\n221\t\n222\t        let throughput_mbs = if let Some(resp) = range_response {\n223\t            let };\n229\t\n230\t        Ok(ProbeInnerResult {\n231\t            connect_time,\n232\t            ttfb,\n233\t            throughput_mbs,\n234\t        })\n235\t    }\n236\t\n237\t    /// Calculate a
